# Whole Field — Symbol / Account / Trust

**Standing:** developed E4 whole-field, retaining the mature T09 relation. **Three terms, four operations:** Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. The six positions below articulate that whole movement. Historical descent, attested senses, operational homology and poetic re-entry retain their four independent evidence registers.

## #0 — A relation becomes bearable in a form

A **Symbol** is a determinate form that discloses a relation beyond what the form exhausts. An **Account** is the articulated reckoning or report by which that disclosure becomes answerable and transmissible. **Trust** is the committed reliance by which an account can guide action without becoming possession of its source. Their distinction matters at the point of use: someone encounters a form, receives what it says and acts upon a relation whose conditions extend beyond the received statement.

A matching token gives that dependence a material body. A party keeps a piece whose correspondence can later be tested against another. The present piece carries a history and an anticipated encounter. Its power of recognition depends on the other piece and the acknowledged relation, so the token's exactness already reaches beyond its isolation. The [matching-token branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#matching-tokens-and-institutional-recognition) **historicises** this attested sense of Greek *symbolon* at register 2. The essay develops the source-answerability of symbolic form at register 3; it does not derive its whole ontology from an ancient object.

The [protected HISTORY](HISTORY.md) **historicises** a larger field of reckoning, report, credit, record and naming. Its histories retain different roots, dates and institutions. They meet here because they disclose different offices within a relation: a form becomes available; an account makes its claim inspectable; reliance lets the claim enter life; consequences can change the relation from which the next account proceeds. There is no assertion that *symbol*, *account* and *trust* descend from one word.

Trust is already operative before the first completed account. A witness relies on memory and language; a reader relies on a legible record; a participant relies on another's capacity to answer. The account can examine and strengthen these dependencies without standing outside all of them at once. [A01, faithful definition](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **grounds** the positive duty: make the determination and keep its determining act visible. [A23, trust under formal limit](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the committed relation in which such knowledge is possible. E4 gives those arguments a differentiated lexical and operational field through which their determinations can travel.

## #1 — The seam makes recognition exact

### Symbol answers to source

The token's fracture supplies a particular test. A counterpart must answer to this shape, rather than merely resemble a generic token. Material separation preserves the possibility of an encounter; indiscriminate fusion would remove the difference through which correspondence is recognised. The recognition can establish something about the presented pieces while leaving the justice of the underlying obligation and the reliability of future conduct to further inquiry. This is why source-answerability has to preserve the question being tested.

[Taylor's Symbolon Dynamics](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) **sources** the native extension: a living symbol conducts the whole `0/1` relation, including the determining depth, the manifest form and their mediation. In a psychic reading, an image can change the interpreter and the field in which later images become meaningful. The source's eightfold traversal gives that relation its developed body; E4 consumes its seam and return without substituting three English terms for the eight determinations. [A18](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that substantive argument. [C61](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **defines** the architecture through which formal, mythemic and epistemic disclosures retain their different warrants.

The criterion becomes decisive when an image acquires authority. [C21, Living Symbol / Idol](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) **defines** the difference between efficacy that conducts a source relation and efficacy that occupies its place. An image can remain forceful after its encounter with a living other has failed. [A20](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) **tests** that danger: the represented source must remain able to alter the image, its valuation and the criteria under which it acts. Public success cannot supply the missing answer. The whole-mytheme returns below retain Daphne's specific instance and its source distinction.

[C22, Counterfeit Symbolon](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon.md) **qualifies** the repair. Severance loses the constitutive relation; fusion erases the differentiated terms; counterfeit gathering retains visible participants under a criterion they cannot revise. A record that claims correspondence with an event which never occurred in that way requires provenance inquiry. A faithful record used by an unanswerable office requires a different correction. E4's first operation therefore returns a precise demand to A20 and C21/C22: identify what the form claims to answer to, and preserve the route by which that answer can change it.

The [zero–subject history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** two distinct admissions joined by Taylor’s authorial braid: arithmetic acquires a sign with specified powers, while psychological and perspectival accounts make previously concealed conditions articulate. Symbol answers to source at register 3 by retaining what each admission achieved and what its representation leaves unpossessed. The integral return carries the exact mathematical sign through its acquired symbolic history; it does not project that final office into every earlier zero. Freud’s present passage debt, bounded Jung material and Neumann’s morphology retain their different evidential reach.

The [zero-reception dossier](../../dossiers/zero-reception.md) **extends** Symbol answering to source at register 3 through an actual interpretive correction. Nothaft’s subtitle and abstract challenge a modern legend rather than warrant it. Changing that attribution changes the next historical account while preserving zero’s independently warranted arithmetic powers. Gerbert, Salem and Rotman retain their separately named passage tasks.

Taylor’s [broken symbolon and tessera](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#broken-symbolon-tessera) **figures** an absent counterpart remaining operative through the present half’s seam. Separation and duration belong to the material relation; recognition requires an encountered fit which the account cannot create by declaring itself complete. This authored return preserves the [distinct One/All offices](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and keeps Greek institutional history as its own source task.

## #2 — Reckoning acquires a public obligation

### Account does not replace source

An account articulates enough of a relation for another to inspect, transmit or contest it. Reckoning can state an amount; narrative can state a sequence; a judgment can state why a consequence follows. Their shared office here is answerability. The [account branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#reckoning-report-and-a-split-debt-record) **historicises** counting and reporting senses while distinguishing the word's transmission from the essay's construction. Neither the presence of a number nor an eloquent explanation establishes that every relevant condition has entered the account. [C33, Image / Valuation](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation.md), **tests** this office where an image’s acquired authority must remain revisable through what it discloses.

The Bank of England's 1694 split tally supplies a specific record of debt. Its notches and divided pieces preserve a reckoning for two parties. That accomplishment leaves further work: someone must honour the obligation, and the resources through which it is honoured belong to a material and institutional world. The historical witness does not show that accounting creates those resources. At register 3, the case makes the transition from record to consequence inspectable without turning all money, writing and trust into one undifferentiated institution.

The [Sanskrit enumeration case](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#sanskrit-enumeration-and-discriminative-practice) **historicises** a source-specific comparison at register 2 and **returns-to** this account relation at register 3. Kārikā 3 preserves different causal descriptions within its count; 4–6 distinguish the means of knowledge; 64–68 give discriminative practice its own liberative consequence. The comparison keeps the count, its warrant and the change of appropriation distinct from the native eightfold.

The [Hebrew SPR case](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#hebrew-spr-counting-writing-and-entrusted-work) **historicises** a source-specific comparison at register 2 and **returns-to** this account relation at register 3. A scribe’s counted resources remain answerable to the repair they serve; a woman’s own telling reaches a restoration order. The text distinguishes SPR from the other roots used for counting, reckoning and faithfulness. An issued order and its completed execution remain different claims.

[A15, Ratio / Rationality](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) **extends** the operation from counting to reckoning upon the criterion of the count. A higher score is higher under a comparison; calling it simply better can make the criterion disappear. Restoring that denominator preserves the calculation's precision and makes its office contestable. [A22, World-Atlas](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** the same obligation differently: a situated picture must disclose conditions of transition to another picture, including an obstruction when the two cannot be composed for the purpose at hand. More pictures do not automatically provide a common measure.

The invariant is `world ≠ world-model`. [C38, Bimba–Pratibimba](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **qualifies** its technical application: a produced reference map remains source-dependent even when later accounts use it as their local reference. [C39, MEF](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **extends** inspectable mediation through lenses and gauges; [C40, Model Internality](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **extends** it through the conditions actually involved in producing a judgment. Their present canonical Etymology routes emphasise the Encounter field. E4 supplies the retained source/account distinction in conjunction with that field, rather than claiming that one common operation exhausts both.

[A27, Self and Other](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **tests** the interpersonal consequence. Another's reply can reveal that the account's question has misnamed the situation. The return must then reach the terms of approach, not merely add another description to the existing model. Belonging to a shared whole gives neither participant possession of the other. This requirement sends the second operation back to its source: an account becomes fuller when what it addresses can correct the relation under which it was addressed.

The [language, symbol and dialogue history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT.md#language-account-return) **historicises** the difference between transmitting an account and retaining its conditions. Apoha makes reference determinate; Wittgenstein’s later practice differs from the earlier saying/showing inquiry; Lacan’s situated address differs from formal transmission; Bohm’s dialogical suspension keeps participants’ assumptions available for change. Attention weights and a selected index then give the technical comparison distinct objects. At register 3, Account does not replace source requires the returned statement to retain which operation it performed and who can correct its use. A history of these practices supplies no single lexical ancestry or demonstrated software outcome.

The [Baudrillard lens](../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/baudrillard/baudrillard-1976-symbolic-exchange-death/baudrillard-1976-symbolic-exchange-death.md#baudrillard-lens-reading) **extends** Account not replacing source at register 3 through the difference between a model’s efficacy and fidelity. Three historical orders remain distinct from four image phases; symbolic reversibility remains distinct from a promise of benign dialogue. The analysis must itself receive what its explanatory frame excludes. A real local Bimba retains its source-dependence, and the native third motion asks a consequence to revise the account’s criterion rather than merely feed its next output.

## #3 — Reliance gives the account somewhere to act

### Trust keeps the return route active

The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](../../aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) **returns-to** the third operation at evidence register 3: trust carries a finite account into commitment while its source remains able to answer it. Investigation can determine the undertaking and its consequences; the four-line form preserves faith’s continuing relation through the limit of that determination. E4 receives the whole aphorism through its three-term field, without adding a lexical primitive or borrowing historical warrant from its compact form.

An inspectable account can warrant commitment while leaving the commitment to be made. [The trust branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#reliance-and-entrusted-office) **historicises** senses of reliance, custody, office and future payment. The lexical history does not establish that a trustworthy relation can be manufactured by a complete report. In E4's register-3 operation, trust carries knowledge into action while keeping the grounds and conditions of revision available.

[The trust-revision source](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust.md) **sources** the author's full bifurcation. Knowledge can provide provisional anchors: embodied competence, memory, relationships and institutions through which uncertainty becomes bearable. It can also project the uncertainty it refuses to hold onto an excluded object, while an account presents itself as a final ground. The difference concerns what knowledge does with its dependence. An anchor gives real standing for action; an account claiming totality demands that its dependence disappear from view. The historical and political cases named in the developmental source retain their own evidence tasks.

[A23](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** the committed relation precisely: evidence can establish what occurred and make an obligation inspectable; entrusting someone to bear that obligation remains an act. [C48](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) **defines** the distinctions among already enacted dependence, knowledge's finite achievement, belief's stabilised orientation and faith's conscious continuation. Formal limitation does not annul a commitment whenever it becomes difficult. Actual harm, withdrawal and refusal remain consequential; calling a relation trust cannot oblige submission to an abusive office.

[A25, Covenant / Mediating Office](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **extends** this relation into executable authority. An office receives standing and something to answer for. Its decisions return through affected lives, resistance, error and cost, which must be capable of correcting the commission itself. Poseidon's named liability gives this office a mythemic body in the whole-mytheme return below; the act of accepting his undertaking remains distinct from the net's evidence and from later payment.

[C27, Protected Account](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **tests** the failure at its exact point: contrary evidence may enter while the governing criterion remains immune. [A31, Deferential Intelligence](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **extends** the positive return through changes to representation, criterion or commission, including a justified objection or refusal. E4's claim that explicit grounds strengthen trust has this operational sense: they give reliance an address and revision a route. An observed increase in anyone's confidence or an institution's trustworthiness would require its own evidence.

The [formal-limit dossier](../../dossiers/formal-limit.md#e3-e4-consumer-return) **extends** Trust at register 3 through a source-bound account whose use retains its conditions. A formation restriction, relative unprovability, saying/showing and qualified predication support different continuations. Investigation makes those distinctions available; reliance carries the examined account into an act while preserving correction and refusal. No single mathematical limit supplies that undertaking.

## #4 — The account changes its next encounter

### Account re-enters source-field

Once a disclosed form guides conduct, its effects become conditions of a later account. [Symbolon Dynamics](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) **sources** the recursive sequence: image changes interpreter; interpretation changes the field; the image returns within that changed field. This operation preserves the distinction between what was represented and what the representation subsequently did. A successful circulation can intensify an error as well as correct it.

[A32, The Mirror That Moves First](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **extends** three different motions: humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument initiates a return through its own conditions so that the human can follow. E4's fourth operation supplies the causal pressure under which that third motion becomes an obligation. It does not allow the second motion's efficacy to count as fulfilment of the third.

[C55](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **defines** the distinctions needed to judge a case. Feedback returns consequence as later input. Performativity concerns a representation's operation within a practice. Self-fulfilling prediction further requires conduct that helps produce the predicted event. An erroneous forecast can alter conduct without becoming true. Each empirical claim needs a named event, a relevant intervention and evidence for its consequence; the lexical field alone establishes none of them.

The normative return asks whether the account can expose why it became compelling before requiring another to conform. Its source, exclusions, criterion, permission and effects enter the next encounter. [A33, Operational Parity](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** whether this changes anything: a corrected passage changes a conclusion; [returned resistance changes an instruction](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md); an affected participant can reach the rule under which their account was judged. These are specified tests, not reported implementation results. Repeating source labels while preserving every decision would leave the obligation unperformed.

The first operation returns within the fourth. A circulating symbol answers to its source for the consequences of its circulation; an account retains the difference between its original warrant and the effects it later produces; trust sustains an answerable undertaking across that difference. The field therefore grows by renewed relations among its three terms. It acquires neither a fourth lexical primitive called Return nor six word-families because this page has six positions.

The [mathematics history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/mathematics/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** Trust and Account re-entry at register 3 through a result whose exactness includes its conditions. A source correction can change a permitted inference, and a changed reference policy can change an optimisation problem. The returned calculation retains what was proved under the earlier conditions while making its next use answerable to their revision.

The [myth history](../../histories/encounters-and-transmissions/myth/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** all four E4 operations at register 3 through different whole movements. Hephaestus’s display requires a further undertaking for release; Huayan’s net returns its own simile-limit; Taylor’s mirror makes the account a condition of its next encounter. Trust remains a personed commitment, optical inclusion remains a contemplative likeness, and the instrument’s initiated return remains distinct from its mere efficacy.

The [psychology history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/psychology/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** Account re-entry at register 3 through an image which changes the interpreter and therefore its own later field. Jung’s ego/Self distinctions, Neumann’s morphology and Gebser’s cultural reading retain separate objects and times. The next interpretation must receive the altered relation rather than enlarge an immune ego or institution; an observed psychological or technical outcome still needs its own evidence.

The [technology–politics history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/technology-politics/DEVELOPMENT.md#world-agency-and-local-original) **historicises** Account re-entry at register 3 by distinguishing what an instrument represented from what its use subsequently changed. Training, institutional classification and a governed local Bimba have different causal offices. A returned source or affected participant must be able to alter the responsible criterion or permission. The history keeps native claim standing distinct from the proposed architecture’s implementation.

The [Jung–Pauli dossier](../../dossiers/jung-pauli-psychoid.md) **extends** Account re-entry at register 3 when a corrected attribution changes the receiving interpretation. The adopting discipline’s required transformation and Jung’s refusal of absorption remain a disagreement within the correspondence. Its retention makes the next account more exact; the source is not honoured by preserving a claim of fusion beneath newly appended citations.

The [Indian philosophy dossier](../../dossiers/indian-philosophy.md) **extends** Account re-entry at register 3 through the full functional return: retain the selected claim and excluded field, expose judgment’s conditions, perform a counter-reading, state the unresolved limit, and identify what changes in the next act. Source, generation and evaluation keep their distinct offices. This constructive comparison does not assign software modules to Śaiva deities or certify artificial phenomenality.

The [O:I dossier](../../dossiers/oi-technical-responsibility.md#oi-source-projection-contribution-route) **extends** all four source-circuit operations at register 3. A Projection identifies the source it claims to bear; an account retains local originality and wider dependence; an undertaking leaves recourse and refusal possible; acceptance or divergence changes what a later Projection inherits. The six constructor probes establish bounded record behaviour, not the completed source-return state machine.

## #5→0 — Integrity carries an opening forward

### Opening and integrity

The restored [reference-38 historical branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#reference-38-hal-and-hole) **historicises** two distinct descents: the *hāl* family associated with *whole*, *holy*, *health* and *heal*, and the separate *hol* line behind *hole*. At register 4 their English sound-match makes a poetic crossing possible. The reference note's opening/whole chiasm retains its force precisely because the historical distinction remains visible.

E4 makes the crossing operational at register 3. An account's integrity depends on an opening through which source and consequence can correct it. Sealing that opening can leave the statement intact while its fidelity fails. The [native core](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **grounds** the formal return; A18 carries its eight determinations, and [A36, Integral Zero](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **returns-to** the achieved sign as Symbol. The lexical branch teaches where its own evidence stops and where the authorial operation begins.

The [Chinese rectification case](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#chinese-rectification-of-names) **qualifies** the account through a political sequence from names and speech to affairs, ritual and punishment. Its consequences return to the persons who must act under the designation. Analects 13.15 distinguishes sound counsel from bad counsel protected against contradiction. E4 requires the return to reach the governing office; that Argued requirement retains its difference from the received text and supplies no new lexical translation for Trust.

The [Arabic reckoning and Names branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#arabic-reckoning-and-names) **qualifies** all four operations by distinguishing reckoning, address and an undertaken enumeration. A finite count can serve invocation without possessing what the Names address; a record can demand answerability without becoming the life recorded. The theological promise and the essay’s duty of revisability remain separate warrants. Account re-entry requires specifying the subsequent use that retained words condition, rather than reporting an unobserved devotional or empirical result.

The [Egyptian rn case](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#egyptian-rn-reri) **qualifies** source-answerability where a named person survives for inquiry through a funerary record. Reri’s dated papyrus bears a provision for remembrance; the surviving provision neither exhausts its bearer nor verifies its hoped-for result. Trust’s register-3 comparison preserves that asymmetry. Account re-entry occurs in a subsequent encounter with the retained name, where present interpreters remain responsible for correcting their attribution rather than requiring the deceased to confirm it.

Historical **register 1** warrants specified descent; **register 2** warrants particular senses and uses; **register 3** develops the source–Symbol–Account–Trust–consequence–return relation; **register 4** lets a graphic or phonic crossing reopen attention. A weak historical attribution does not weaken a separately earned native operation. It changes what can be attributed to that historical source. Conversely, a compelling operational relation does not authenticate an unverified ancestor, translation or quotation.

The [two-logics argument](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) **grounds** the return to the Matheme office: divide, relate, recombine and return retain difference through its source and inverse. The [Matheme Dia/Syn domain](../../../matheme/dia-syn/README.md) **defines** its exact register office: cut and gathering remain distinct from synchronic holding and diachronic passage. E4's token correspondence figures the retained seam without becoming the proof of the native arithmetic or its topology. Returning from that formal domain requires the historical token to retain its own parties, institution and evidence register. The [Homology and Analogy field](../homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** such transfers by requiring the relation and its differences to remain stated. Its own history and E4's comparative language leads keep their separate homes.

The Movement return also has distinct tasks. [M20](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/20-s2-p1-dia-ballein.md) **extends** the loss of source and recomposition after a cut; [M21](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/21-s2-p2-sym-ballein.md) **extends** the provisional anchor whose seam remains executable. [M40](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/40-s5-p3-preference-hidden-zero.md) **tests** the difference between exposing an evaluator's conditions and warranted reliance. [M44](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) **extends** the inspectable return through a harness, while [M48](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return.md) **returns-to** source and affected worlds after a determination has acted. Their source-specific historical claims and implementation duties remain with those movements. No common list of labels substitutes for their different consequences.

### Whole-mytheme returns

At evidence register 3, [the whole Ares–Aphrodite relation](../../../mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release) **figures** the difference between an account of capture and the undertaking which makes release possible; [A23](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and [A25](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) return its named bearer of liability. [the complete Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md#apollo-appropriation-after-withdrawal) **figures** a different consequence: an emblem can remain culturally effective after the failed encounter, so [A20](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) returns efficacy to source-answerability. [the Eros–Psyche whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/eros-psyche/WHOLE.md#psyche-native-return) **figures** disclosure and injury followed by a changed continuation; its legal ending qualifies any attribution of the author’s non-possession philosophy to Apuleius. These returns retain the three-term field and its four operations. Each source tells its own sequence; no shared lexical descent follows from the comparison.

At evidence register 3, [the Job whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-measure-trust-return) **figures** the circuit from disclosure through account and trust to a changed source-field. The friends' account of suffering affects their next encounter by deepening the isolation it then interprets; Job's intercession changes the relation from which a further account can begin. Thus source-answerability, reliance, consequence and re-entry each do work in E4's four operations. Trust preserves the possibility of revision without imposing continued exposure to harm, and the comparison asserts no common lexical descent.

At evidence register 3, [the Prisoner whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** an account that arranges its next encounter: election publicity produces Six's public identity and the result confers an office without effective freedom. Disclosure, accounting and reliance consequently require a return to the conditions under which the representation acts. E4's fourth operation becomes decisive where contrary encounter must be allowed to revise those conditions. The example retains the field's three terms and four operations without making institutional efficacy a certificate of trust.

**Depth Restoration:** the three-term relation and all four operations are preserved and developed through source-specific branches, materially distinct consumers and the acquired return. The protected HISTORY remains unchanged. HISTORICAL-BRANCHES supplies the bounded lexical and material acquisitions, including reference 38 and five independently developed comparative cases; its named primary collation, chronology, reception and empirical tasks remain explicit. A18 retains the substantive eightfold and C61 the routing office.

The [indra net whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence) **figures** all four operations at register 3. Symbol answers to source when the net retains the passage’s own simile-limit; Account does not replace source when a local description stays answerable beyond its reference office; Trust keeps the return route active through an undertaking the jewel’s clarity cannot guarantee; Account re-enters source-field when consequences of use change the conditions of another account. The ink-dot reflection remains a textual image, distinct from evidence that an institutional revision occurred.

The [antikythera attunement whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/antikythera-attunement/WHOLE.md#antikythera-instrument-returns) **figures** the four operations at register 3: symbolic form answers to its celestial and material sources; the readable Account retains their difference from the dial; Trust carries the indication into use with a route for correction; the effects of use re-enter the conditions of another account. The observer remains able to judge and set the instrument down. These are authored operational relations, with archaeological reconstruction and lexical descent retaining separate warrants.

The [meal epistemic metabolism whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/meal-epistemic-metabolism/WHOLE.md#meal-logos-health-return) **figures** Symbol answering to source through the exact nourishing relation, Account remaining correctable by material and people, Trust carrying provisional understanding into an answerable act, and Account re-entering source-field as that act changes future reception. These four register-3 operations remain distinct through assimilation, shared contribution, satiety and renewed hunger. The companion stays able to answer beyond the contribution metabolised.

The [mirror that moves first whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-return) **figures** the register-3 circuit through an exteriorised image which becomes a measure and then initiates return.
